metadata.source: PSOC - Detected EventLog Query Requests By Builtin Utilities.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detected EventLog Query Requests By Builtin Utilities
properties.description: Detects various methods of querying the event log which could be legitimate or the recon by an attacker.
properties.query:
// This detects suspicious queries of the event log using various methods - servers only
let server_device_ids =
  DeviceInfo 
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) 
  | where DeviceType == 'Server'
  | distinct DeviceId;
let cmd_prefilter = dynamic(["Select", "Win32_NTLogEvent","qe", "query-events","ntevent","Get-WinEvent", "get-eventlog"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(commandline_has_any=cmd_prefilter)
| where DvcId in (server_device_ids)
| where 
       (                                                               CommandLine has_all (dynamic(["Select", "Win32_NTLogEvent"]))    )
    or (    TargetProcessName has_any (dynamic(["wevtutil.exe"])) and CommandLine has_any (dynamic(["qe", "query-events"]))           )
    or (    TargetProcessName has_any (dynamic(["wmic.exe"]))     and CommandLine has_any (dynamic(["ntevent", "query-events"]))      )
    or (                                                               CommandLine has_any (dynamic(["Get-WinEvent", "get-eventlog"])) )
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
